guard: Manager.stop with withAgents true waits for every seat to exit; a plain stop leaves those seats running
why: The deterministic shutdown cell gives both target seats a runtime exit witness and asserts stop proves both exits before returning.
A second cell makes one runtime stop throw and its wait report still-running; shutdown must fail loud rather than release authority into an orphan window.
A third cell is the #964 spare path: a plain stop must not call handle.stop. Restoring the old always-reap line reddens only that cell.

mutations.name: release manager authority immediately after requesting seat stops
mutations.expectRed: shutdown: stop() proves every managed child exited before releasing manager authority
mutations.cell: shutdown: stop() proves every managed child exited before releasing manager authority

mutations.name: the defect restored: a plain stop still reaps every managed agent
mutations.find:
if (opts?.withAgents === true) await this.teardownManagedAgents();
      else this.detachManagedAgents();
mutations.expectRed: spare: a plain stop does not hard-stop the child
mutations.cell: spare: a plain stop does not hard-stop the child
mutations.note: Issue #964 restored: stop() on the active path always tears down children. The withAgents:true cells stay green; only the spare cell reddens.
